[BEGIN]
module TopModule (
    input  logic       clk,
    input  logic [7:0] d,
    output logic [7:0] q
);

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : dff
            always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
                q[i] <= d[i];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

endmodule
[DONE]
